description:
A historic crossover seventy-five years in the making! The Shadow, Doc Savage, and The Avenger, the three iconic crime-fighters first introduced in the pulp magazines of Street & Smith Publications, come together for the first time ever to avert global catastrophe!

Out of tragedy, a hero is born... and an alliance formed! When an airliner carrying industrialist Richard Henry Benson and his family disappears, it's the first strike in a secret cabal's master plan for world conquest. As genius adventurer Doc Savage and brutal vigilante The Shadow attempt to avert disaster with their science and bullets, Benson rises from the ashes with a fearsome new identity: The Avenger. Can three men of contrasting ideology and methodology cast aside their inherent differences and band together to conquer the overwhelming threat of the Voodoo Master and his mysterious allies?

Experience the origin story of Fire Fist Ace, the legendary older brother of Straw Hat Luffy, in this exciting manga by renowned artist Boichi! Adventure along with Ace as he gathers a loyal crew of like-minded buccaneers—including Masked Deuce, Mihal, Skull, and the wild Kotatsu, and forms the Spade Pirates. Witness the power of the Devil Fruit as it bestows Fire Fist’s fearsome punching power! Piratical feats abound as Ace and his Spade Pirates head toward the New World and the dreaded Captain Whitebeard. Don’t miss the bonus chapter featuring Straw Hat swordsman Zolo!

Chapter Titles

  • Chapter 1: The Formation of the Spade Pirates
  • Chapter 2: Son of a Demon
  • One Piece Remix: Zolo Overboard

Taken prisoner by the Whitebeard Pirates, Ace continues to challenge the great Emperor of the Sea, knowing that he’ll never be King of the Pirates if he can’t best all his rivals. After exchanging blows time and time again, the proximity to Whitebeard’s fiery soul begins to have an effect on Ace…Will his life be forever changed? Experience Ace’s backstory in never-before-published scenes of excitement and daring! Also, check out artist Boichi’s bonus rendition of Nami and Kalifa’s battle from Enies Lobby!

Chapter Titles

  • Chapter 3: That Kind of Pirate
  • Final Chapter: Ace's Adventure
  • One Piece Remix: Nami vs. Kalifa

Status Royale is THE game to master if you want to join the rank of elite players in the competitive world of VR esports. Vell is just having fun as a casual gamer with her best friend and teammate Jun teaching her the tips and tricks…until he shuts her down and skips town! Vell’s competitive spirit is unlocked and she vows to challenge her former best friend with her own team of amateur Status Royale players and beat Jun at his own game, but does she really know who she’s competing against?

Mission success! Vell and her new Team Guillotine teammates, Henry and Pepper, advance to the next round of their esports tournament debut! Not only has Vell impressed her gamer idol Bunni from the Starstrikers, but Team Guillotine’s surprising win also catches the eye of wealthy entrepreneur Shae Chevalier, who’s looking for an underdog story as her next trendy investment. But the game is not over yet. Vell is still behind in the chase to defeat Jun as he joins one of the top pro teams in the nation, the New York Dollars. Can Vell and her team level up in time for their next showdown, or has Jun become unstoppable?

Stories Include:

Adventures of Homer Ghost- Homer and the Ghost Gang offer to track down Tony Toughguy but get interrupted by attempting to help a stranger find his gun, bullets, bags of money and get to the train.

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer has plenty of time to get to school, until Mama askes him to do something for her.

Zelda the Scatter-brained Witch- Zelda wins the mask contest, even though she wasn't even wearing a mask.

Adventures of Homer the Ghost- Homer and the Ghost Gang see the movie Moby Dick and this leads them to catch their own whale. Things seems be going okay until they are eaten by the whale and learn that there is a fine for whale hunting.

Dugan the Dead-end Ghost- Dugan shows Homer his new game of knocking hats off the fence.

Snappy the Ghost Dog- Snappy torments the local dog catcher by just being himself.

The Ghost Gang- Homer wins the Ghost Gangs race, by not even knowing he was in a race to begin with.

Coloring Page- A coloring page drawn by Stan Lee.

The Dinosaur- Story about a Dinosaur

Adventure of Homer Ghost- Homer falls asleep reading Sleeping Beauty and dreams of fighting The Sorcerer for the fair Sleeping Beauty, but things go wrong when Homer realizes Sleeping Beauty might not be the right name for the princess.

Melvin the Mixed-up Ghost- Melvin and Gobby share the sled.

Alice the Little Girl Ghost- Homer offers to take Alice to the dance but she needs to do her chores before she can go. Homer is all too happy to help, but he then too tired to go the dance.

Writer Brandon (NBSG: Zarek) Jerwa is joined series artist Jackson Herbert for this all new series which tells the untold tale of the crew of the Battlestar Galactica! Set approximately two years before the SCI FI mini-series which relaunched Battlestar Galactica to such acclaim, the 7-issues collected here (including #0) follows Commander Adama and crew as they take on their first mission on board the Galactica. Everything in that time frame is explored, including the menace and return of the Cylons as events hurtle towards the Apocalypse! Also includes a complete cover gallery!

Following directly from the 2007 Dynamite Free Comic Book Day Comic - read by over 100,000 fans on Free Comic Book Day - comes the all-new Battlestar Galactica series - Season Zero is here! And now, the back half of the acclaimed series 9issue s7-12) are collected here in Volume Two of the series!
